# Connected Car, AWS IoT Core / EMQX Telemetry, T-Box/MHU & FOTA/SOTA (ISO 21434) (`automotive-connected-car-ota-tbox`)

> **Group:** IV. IoT, Automotive, Robotics & OT
> **Product Archetypes:** IoT_Telematics_Broker, Automotive_Connected_Car, CyberPhysical_OT_Robotics
> **Trigger Signals:** iot, mqtt, emqx, tbox, mhu, fota, sota, ota, vin, telematics, ecu, can, uds, autosar, vehicle, ccar, ccp

## [ BLOCK: mqtt-broker-acl-and-telemetry-surveillance ]
### MQTT Broker ACLs (AWS IoT Core / EMQX), Topic Wildcards & Live GPS/Telemetry Leak
- Verify whether MQTT clients can subscribe to wildcard topics (`#`, `+`, `/mobile/{VIN}/push`, `/server/{VIN}/remctrl`) for VINs they do not own.
- Audit telemetry payloads (2,000+ keys) for leaked owner PII, pre-signed camera URLs, PKI material, or remote command acknowledgments.

## [ BLOCK: fota-sota-signing-and-tbox-pairing ]
### FOTA/SOTA Package Signing, Anti-Rollback & T-Box / Head-Unit (MHU) Pairing
- Trace the OTA trust chain (UN/ECE R156): verify cryptographic signature verification, version anti-rollback checks, and e-contract signing before firmware installation.
- Audit MHU/T-Box pairing flows (`/mhu/send-otp/{vinCode}`, `/tbox/frs`) to ensure staging OTP sinks (`/fake/otp`) or unauthenticated device endpoints cannot hijack vehicle pairing.

## [ BLOCK: tbox-session-revocation-and-command-audit-logging ]
### Vehicle Session/Key Revocation (ASVS V7) & Remote Actuation Audit Trail (ASVS V16)
- Verify that remote vehicle commands (unlock, climate, immobilizer, trunk, horn, FOTA trigger) require fresh token/PIN verification, monotonic anti-replay nonces, and vehicle speed/gear safety preconditions (`speed == 0`, `gear == PARK`).
- Check that ownership transfer or stolen-vehicle mode immediately revokes cached T-Box/MHU tokens, MQTT ACLs, and BLE keys, and writes an immutable audit log.

### Standard Mappings
- ISO-SAE-21434, UNECE-R155, UNECE-R156, OWASP-API1:2023, ASVS-V7, ASVS-V16

### Safe Patterns (Refutation Anchors)
- Per-device X.509 mTLS certificate and IoT broker ACL restricting publish/subscribe strictly to the device's own VIN topic
- End-to-end cryptographic signature verification (Ed25519/RSA-PSS) and anti-rollback version check on FOTA/SOTA manifests before ECU flashing
- Remote actuation API enforces caller-to-VIN ownership, monotonic command nonce/timestamp, and vehicle stationary safety state

### Vulnerable Patterns
- MQTT broker ACL allowing wildcard subscriptions (+, #) across all VIN telemetry or remote-control topics
- Remote vehicle command endpoint accepting a VIN parameter without verifying that the authenticated user is the active owner/authorized driver
- OTA package download or installation over plain HTTP or without cryptographic signature and anti-rollback verification

### Mandatory Evidence (`required_evidence`)
- ev_... excerpt of MQTT/IoT policy template or broker ACL verifier
- ev_... excerpt of remote command handler or FOTA/SOTA package verification and pairing flow

### Verification Questions When Static Code Is Inconclusive (`questions_when_unclear`)
- Does the in-vehicle T-Box / Gateway ECU independently verify command signatures and vehicle speed/park state before forwarding frames to the CAN bus?
- Are AWS IoT Core / EMQX topic ACLs dynamically scoped per certificate CN=${iot:ClientId}?
